title: Digital Notebook Organization
description: Organize notes into Sections, Pages, Tags, and shared team notebooks.

steps.title: OneNote Hierarchy
steps.content: OneNote mimics a physical binder with Notebooks -> Sections (tabs) -> Pages.

quiz.question: How is content structured in Microsoft OneNote?
quiz.explanation: OneNote follows the traditional ring-binder metaphor: Notebooks contain colored Section tabs, which hold individual Pages.
